Source counter: ImportKey reports "Total Shipments 33110 Records detected" for this entity; 5 export rows were actually visible on the free page (plus 5 buyer rows with counts).
note: HS 650610 (helmets) matches the declared code exactly — no HS correction needed. Export side is factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L records with destination, HS code and BOL number, not by website claims. Domestic supply evidence could NOT be verified: GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders and annual-report splits were not retrievable — search engines (DuckDuckGo/searx) were unreachable or returned irrelevant results, and volza/eximpedia returned HTTP 403. Revenue and domestic turnover are therefore null, not estimated. Note the two ImportKey slugs resolve to different addresses (Plot No. 48, Sector-68 IMT vs 23/7 Mathura Road, Ballabgarh) and different shipment totals (5252 vs 33110) — likely the same group with multiple IEC/addresses, but this was not independently confirmed. Role: manufacturer (own factory at Ballabgarh; also imports raw materials — printing ink, metal flake, speakers, MOSFETs — for captive consumption, consistent with in-house helmet production). Industry label 'Строительство и DIY' (construction/DIY) is wrong for this company: it is a two-wheeler helmet and accessories manufacturer.
